# DenseHighOrderInteractions

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A connectivity pattern where each neuron interacts with many others simultaneously, involving multiplicative or polynomial combinations of inputs rather than simple sums. Increases computational expressiveness per node, enabling richer dynamics and more efficient information storage in topology-centric computing substrates.
